notes.title: The Linux Version is Live!
notes.content:
At long last the linux version of Starship Turd Nugget is now live on Steam!

Please checkout the system requirements before you purchase the game, just to be safe ;-)

It was an interesting experience shipping the linux version of the game. I learned a few things in the process, and I'm happy to be able to bring joy to the people of yet another OS platform =)

BTW you'll notice in the leaderboard that the there's a pictographic reference to the OS that the score was posted from.  I'm excited to see which OS has the most competitive players ;-)

Happy blasting!

Paul Glinker
Glinkie Games Inc.
